provider.notes: Registered at gateway/src/plugin/builtin/mod.rs:1778-1781; dispatched at gateway/src/core/stt/standard.rs:464-465. MODEL KEY: the model id is Tencent's engine id (engine_model_type on the socket, engine_type on flash, EngSerViceType on SentenceRecognition). Language is chosen by the engine id; there is no separate language parameter. An empty model resolves to 16k_zh (gateway/src/core/stt/tencent/config.rs:39, fallback at :173). Ids are case-sensitive on the wire (16k_zh-TW, 16k_zh-PY, Hy-ASR-3.0-preview); match.model keeps the vendor's spelling, which is what a non-native adapter sends. SITES: the two synchronous file APIs (flash and SentenceRecognition) exist on the China site only, recorded as the region constraint 'china' on those transports; the international site offers the real-time socket and an asynchronous job. Streaming concurrency differs by site (200 connections per account on the China site, 50 for real-time version 2 engines, 20 on the international site); each socket transport's rates entry records one figure and its note says which. STREAMING CLIENT (adapter native, known_broken; read from code and vendor documentation, never run against the vendor; all paths under gateway/src/core/stt/tencent/): (1) messages.rs:158-165 treats slice_type 1 as a finished segment and client.rs:430-436 sets is_final for it, but the vendor defines 1 as an unstable in-progress result and 2 as the only stable one, so every growing partial reaches turn-taking as a final transcript. (2) Hang-up sends a WebSocket Close frame (client.rs:118, :177) and never the vendor end message {"type":"end"}; is_speech_final is set from final==1 (client.rs:441) but the vendor's final message carries no result, so it is never emitted. (3) The signed URL and voice_id are built once (client.rs:494) and reused on every reconnect (client.rs:544); the vendor voids a voice_id after any interruption. (4) Vendor sentence detection (needvad) follows the customer's vad_events feature (config.rs:859-861), so vad_events=false silently turns vendor endpointing off. (5) Unknown engine ids become 16k_zh (config.rs:173) and STTConfig.language is never read, so a request that sets only a language runs Mandarin. (6) Hot words are sent as Base64 JSON (signature.rs:276-285) where the vendor expects 'word|weight' pairs. The repository mock (gateway/tests/mock_endpoint_e2e.rs:420-431) sends result and final in one message, a shape the vendor page does not show, so its passing test covers none of this. FILE UPLOAD (not implemented; flash through adapter regional_rest, SentenceRecognition as planned_file, which no release builds): batch_provider_supported (gateway/src/core/stt/batch.rs:839-844) lists only deepgram, assemblyai, openai and elevenlabs, and the Tencent feature row has batch_builder None (gateway/src/core/capabilities.rs:362-365). The two interfaces are told apart by dialect.wire: tencent_flash and tencent_sentence_recognition. Neither returns a confidence, a no-speech probability or a detected language, so quality filtering can only drop empty text. Concurrency limits are per Tencent account, so the limiter must be shared by every call on the account. Byte limits the vendor states as '100 MB' and '3 MB' are recorded with the decimal reading, the lower one. STATE TODAY: the streaming client is the native transport, enabled from Release 0, groundwork and honest refusal, and reported as known broken in ready.stt rather than refused (integration decisions, section 15); each native transport carries its defect. The file transport (regional_rest) is enabled from Release 5, wider vendor coverage and hardening, and only after a live probe with a real key (decisions section 12). Until then a model the gateway has no working path for is refused or warned as its when_unusable says. Segmentation is required only for 16k_zh-PY and 16k_zh_dialect, and only for China-site accounts. config/pricing.rs has no Tencent entries, so rows carry no pricing_key. LIVE TESTING: the research machine could not resolve asr.cloud.tencent.com or asr.tencentcloudapi.com, so no defect and no vendor fact in these rows was checked against the live service; that needs a host inside mainland China or one whose DNS resolves the Tencent API hosts.

rates.note: Free concurrency per account (AppId) for standard engines, shared by every call on the account; add-on packs buy more.

context_params.note: Entries are written 'word|weight' and joined with commas; a word is at most 30 characters.

gateway_client.notes: Raw audio body. The signature is the socket's HMAC-SHA1 scheme (signature.rs:502-534) with 'POST' prefixed to the string to sign, sent in an Authorization header; the timestamp must be within 3 minutes of server time. A non-zero 'code' in an HTTP 200 reply is an error; 4006 is account concurrency exceeded and should be treated as back-pressure.

segment_profile.rationale: 6000 ms is the audit's starting value, not a measurement; no short-clip latency is published. Replace it with measured P99 plus a margin.

Three ids in the gateway's engine list are in no current vendor engine list and land here: 8k_zh_s, 16k_zh_video and 16k_ca. The gateway sends these three verbatim on the socket today (gateway/src/core/stt/tencent/config.rs:129-149), and its plugin metadata advertises 16k_ca (gateway/src/plugin/builtin/mod.rs:455-457). No synchronous file API lists them either, so file upload is a guess the vendor will probably reject; confirm each id against the live service and give it an exact row, or remove it from the gateway's engine list and metadata.
